The researcher scored against a copy of lrg_dialogue.php taken at 18:36; the file at 19:13 carries 'pt19c-A fix 1' (767 diff lines): lrgDlgWordsCarry (strict-word precision >= 0.75 before any F1/trigram pick on the fast path), token-aligned containment, 'a one-token entry or one with no strict meaning word is explicit only when said exactly', single-entry 'content outranks the refusal regex', new assent idioms, a new question test. Every sentence was re-run through the current functions.

METHOD 2 - class grading re-implemented wrongly. build.py's is_commit() is not lrgDlgIsCommit/lrgDlgHubFlags: (a) it ignores the Invisible Continue flag, which the build grades scripted=1 (capability map U2; 33 of the 229 beats carry invis=1); (b) it counts a scripted sibling only with goodbye / a twat target / links leaving the layer, while the build counts every scripted sibling that is not a hub question (no links = branching away).
